pages.title: Mirror Processor
pages.text: A chip of antisilicon on an anticarbon die. It runs any program at all - with positrons instead of electrons, and current flowing the other way.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Etched in the Foundry. It is the first circuit I have made that would work equally well on either side of the mirror.
Made in $(item)Mirror Matter Foundry$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Mirror Metallurgy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Baryogenesis Seed, Dimensional Residue, Omega Point.
